name: Taco Twist Bake
description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

_similar.name: Taco Ring
_similar.description: A savory taco-flavored ring made with crescent rolls, ground beef, and cheese, served with salsa and fresh toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry the hamburger and let it cool.
Add ¼ cup water and taco seasoning mix to the fried hamburger.
Lay the crescent roll dough on the outside edge of a 15-inch pizza-style pan, forming a circle with the pointed edge out.
Scoop the hamburger mixture onto the dough, leaving a 5-inch wide circle in the center.
Add shredded cheese on top of the hamburger mixture.
Bring the pointed edge of the pastry over the beef mixture and press to seal.
Bake for approximately 16 minutes or as per the directions on the pastry package until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before serving.
To serve, remove the top from the green pepper and scoop out the insides. Place salsa inside the green pepper.
Place the green pepper in the middle of the ring along with shredded lettuce and tomato. Serve with sour cream.

_similar.keywords: taco ring, crescent roll recipe, taco bake, Mexican-inspired

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.name: Mexican Enchilada Bake
_similar.description: A hearty, layered casserole featuring chicken, tortillas, and a rich tomato-salsa sauce, topped with cheese and sour cream.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups tomato sauce or ¾ cup each diced carrots and diced canned tomatoes
1 can (19 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Combine tomato sauce, salsa, 2 teaspoons chili powder, and 2 teaspoons cumin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, rice, beans, carrots, red pepper, onion, lime juice, cilantro, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin.
Spray a 9×13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
To assemble the casserole, spread 1 cup of sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 6 tortillas over the bottom, overlapping as necessary.
Spoon another 1 cup of sauce over the tortillas and spread evenly. Top with half of the bean mixture and half of the cheese.
Arrange the remaining tortillas, top with another 1 cup of sauce, followed by the remaining bean mixture and remaining cheese.
Spoon any remaining sauce over the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Top individual servings with a dollop of sour cream.

_similar.keywords: enchilada bake, Mexican casserole, chicken recipe

_similar.name: Beef Taco Bake
_similar.description: A hearty, cheesy taco-inspired casserole made with ground beef, tortillas, and a creamy tomato soup sauce, perfect for a family dinner.
recipeIngredient: 6 (8-inch) flour tortillas or 8 (6-inch) corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 can (10¾ oz) Campbell's condensed tomato soup
1 cup Pace thick & chunky salsa or picante sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef until browned, stirring to separate the meat.
Drain excess fat from the skillet.
Add the tomato soup, salsa, milk, tortillas, and half of the cheddar cheese to the cooked beef. Mix well.
Spoon the mixture into a 2-quart shallow baking dish.
Cover the dish and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top before serving.

_similar.keywords: taco bake, ground beef, cheesy casserole, Mexican-American

_similar.name: Zippy Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A flavorful and spicy spaghetti sauce with sausage, hamburger, and taco seasoning.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the hamburger and chopped onion.
Add garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
Chop the summer sausage into 1/4 inch pieces and add to the mixture.
Add the Ragu spaghetti sauce and drained mushrooms.
